csv_scope_of_work: The Virginia department of transportation may be seeking a consultant to provide a Planning/Design for Warwick Blvd and Main St Intersection. Improvements include signal upgrades to support protected-permissive left turns along all approaches of the Warwick Boulevard and Main Street intersection. Installation of high visibility crosswalks and enhanced pedestrian safety features. Retiming vehicle and pedestrian phases to support coordination between two adjacent signal systems.
